patch_description: Cross-over of the two programs: keep the direct constrained optimization (maximize min distance subject to diameter <= 1) from the SLSQP-based script, which achieved 0.98, but enrich the multistart initialization with the icosahedron-plus-perturbed-poles structured start from the current program (a strong candidate configuration for 14 points). We run SLSQP from several starts (structured icosa, Fibonacci, and seeded random unit vectors), track the best dmin/dmax ratio, and fall back gracefully. The icosa start typically converges faster and to better local optima, while the random starts add diversity. Only a handful of starts are used to keep runtime well under the timeout (the reference took ~7s with 10 starts; we use 6 and tighter maxiter).
